chunks.ar: هرب الشاعر المتلمس من الملك النعمان بن المنذر،
chunks.en_old: The poet al-Mutalammis fled King al-Numan
chunks.en_new: The poet al-Mutalammis fled from King al-Numan ibn al-Mundhir

chunks.ar: وغاب عن أهله زمنًا طويلًا.
chunks.en_old: and remained away for a long time.
chunks.en_new: and was away from his family for a long time.

chunks.ar: انتظرته زوجته أميمة بقلق، ولم يصلها منه خبر يطمئنها،
chunks.en_old: His wife Umaymah waited anxiously
chunks.en_new: His wife Umaymah waited anxiously, with no news of him to reassure her,

chunks.ar: حتى شاع بين الناس أنه مات ولن يعود.
chunks.en_old: until people began to believe he was dead.
chunks.en_new: until word spread among the people that he had died and would not return.

chunks.ar: كانت أميمة تحب زوجها حبًا كبيرًا،
chunks.en_old: Umaymah loved him deeply
chunks.en_new: Umaymah loved him deeply

chunks.ar: ولذلك رفضت أن تتزوج غيره.
chunks.en_old: and refused to remarry.
chunks.en_new: and refused to remarry.

chunks.ar: لكن أهلها قالوا إن عليها أن تبدأ حياة جديدة،
chunks.en_old: Her relatives urged her to begin anew,
chunks.en_new: But her family said she must begin a new life,

chunks.ar: وإن الانتظار لا فائدة منه بعدما انقطعت أخبار الرجل كل تلك السنوات.
chunks.en_old: arguing that years without news made further waiting hopeless.
chunks.en_new: and that waiting was useless after all those years without news of him.

chunks.ar: كثر الذين طلبوا يدها،
chunks.en_old: Many suitors came.
chunks.en_new: Many men asked for her hand,

chunks.ar: واستمر ضغط أهلها عليها حتى وافقت أخيرًا، وهي غير مطمئنة إلى قرارها.
chunks.en_old: Finally she agreed reluctantly,
chunks.en_new: and her family kept pressing her until she finally agreed, though uneasy about her decision.

chunks.ar: حددوا ليلة للزفاف، واجتمع الناس في الحي،
chunks.en_old: and the family arranged a wedding.
chunks.en_new: They set a night for the wedding, and people gathered in the camp,

chunks.ar: وسمعت أصوات الغناء والدفوف من الخيام.
chunks.en_old: Songs and drums sounded through the camp on the appointed night.
chunks.en_new: and the sound of singing and drums came from the tents.

chunks.ar: وفي تلك الليلة نفسها عاد المتلمس من سفره،
chunks.en_old: On that very night al-Mutalammis returned
chunks.en_new: That very night al-Mutalammis returned from his journey

chunks.ar: ورأى الزينة وسمع الفرح.
chunks.en_old: and saw the celebration.
chunks.en_new: and saw the decorations and heard the celebration.

chunks.ar: سأل صبيانًا عن سبب الاحتفال،
chunks.en_old: Children told him that Umaymah,
chunks.en_new: He asked some boys the reason for the celebration,

chunks.ar: فأخبروه أن أميمة، زوجة المتلمس الذي يظنونه ميتًا، تتزوج رجلًا آخر.
chunks.en_old: the wife of the man everyone thought dead, was marrying someone else.
chunks.en_new: and they told him that Umaymah, wife of al-Mutalammis, whom they thought dead, was marrying another man.

chunks.ar: دهش الشاعر وتألم، ثم دخل بين الحاضرين دون أن يعرفه أحد.
chunks.en_old: Shocked and hurt, the poet entered unnoticed among the guests.
chunks.en_new: The poet was shocked and hurt, then slipped in among the guests without anyone recognizing him.

chunks.ar: رأى أميمة قرب العريس الجديد، وكانت حزينة رغم الاحتفال.
chunks.en_old: He saw Umaymah grieving beside her new groom,
chunks.en_new: He saw Umaymah near the new groom, sad despite the celebration.

chunks.ar: وعندما اقترب العريس منها، تنهدت وأخذت تردد بيتًا من الشعر.
chunks.en_old: and she began to recite a sorrowful verse.
chunks.en_new: When the groom came near her, she sighed and began repeating a line of verse.
chunks.note: omitted groom approaching and her sigh

chunks.ar: تساءلت أميمة في بيتها أين أصبح زوجها الغائب،
chunks.en_old: Umaymah wondered aloud in verse
chunks.en_new: In her verse Umaymah wondered where her absent husband had gone,

chunks.ar: وفي أي أرض بعيدة يعيش إن كان حيًا.
chunks.en_old: where her absent husband might be.
chunks.en_new: and in what far land he lived, if he was still alive.
chunks.note: omitted 'in what far land, if alive'

chunks.ar: لم يستطع المتلمس أن يصمت، فأجابها ببيت من شعره
chunks.en_old: Al-Mutalammis answered with his own verse:
chunks.en_new: Al-Mutalammis could not stay silent, and answered her with a verse of his own

chunks.ar: يقول إنه قريب، وإنه لم ينس حبها.
chunks.en_old: he was close at hand and had never forgotten her.
chunks.en_new: saying that he was near and had not forgotten his love for her.

chunks.ar: عرفت أميمة صوت زوجها،
chunks.en_old: Umaymah recognized her husband’s voice.
chunks.en_new: Umaymah recognized her husband's voice,

chunks.ar: وفهم العريس الجديد حقيقة ما حدث.
chunks.en_old: The new groom understood at once
chunks.en_new: and the new groom understood what had really happened.

chunks.ar: لم يغضب الرجل ولم يخاصمهما، بل أنشد كلمات تدل على أنه سيتنحى،
chunks.en_old: and, without quarreling, spoke graciously
chunks.en_new: The man did not grow angry or quarrel with them, but recited words showing he would step aside,
chunks.note: omitted that he would step aside

chunks.ar: ثم ترك لهما المكان وانصرف دون أن يعود.
chunks.en_old: and withdrew, leaving the reunited couple alone.
chunks.en_new: then left the place to them and went away, never to return.

chunks.ar: عاد المتلمس إلى أميمة بعد غياب ظنه الناس نهاية حياته.
chunks.en_old: After an absence everyone mistook for death,
chunks.en_new: Al-Mutalammis returned to Umaymah after an absence people had thought was the end of his life.

chunks.ar: وبقي الزوجان معًا في راحة وسرور بعد أن زال سوء الفهم،
chunks.en_old: al-Mutalammis and Umaymah were together again.
chunks.en_new: The couple stayed together in peace and happiness once the misunderstanding was cleared,

chunks.ar: وصارت ليلة الزفاف التي بدت حزينة يومًا لعودتهما إلى بعضهما.
chunks.en_old: The wedding night became the night of their reunion.
chunks.en_new: and the wedding night that had seemed sad became a day of their return to each other.
